name: Enema
source:
School girl Ezaki Ema meets a space police boy Nema who comes to the Earth to fight parasites laying eggs at the stomach. Together they purify stomachs of school girls and fight parasites with a gravitational vibrator.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女学生江崎惠真遇到了太空警察男孩尼玛，他来到地球对抗在胃里产卵的寄生虫。他们一起净化女学生的胃，并用重力振动器对抗寄生虫。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
